english.title: Use a laden motor vehicle with a lateral projection exceeding 2.9 metres but less than 4.3m
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), carrying a load so that the overall width of the vehicle together with the width of

(A)_[a lateral projection]_
(B)_[the lateral projections]_

of its load exceeded 2.9 metres.
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 82(2)(b) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
used on a road
a vehicle carrying a load
overall lateral projection of the vehicle
exceeded 2.9 metres

english.notes:
(i) See regulation 82(2) for exceptions.
(ii) See offence wording H2545, H2546 and H3055 for lateral projection of laden vehicle exceeding 305 mm.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iv) See also offence wordings: H2552 and H2553.
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant used **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) when the overall width of the vehicle was **(..SPECIFY THE WIDTH..) metres. The maximum permitted width of this vehicle, when laden, was 2.9 metres.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
